name: 34744 · Kissimmee, FL
findings: ZIP 34744 (Kissimmee) has 212 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34744 (Kissimmee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34744 (Kissimmee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
